subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Over-Fitting to Small Samples
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Over-Fitting to Small Samples.

hook.text: A coin lands heads three times. You bet heads next. But the coin is fair. Three flips are not enough data.

buildup.text: Over-Fitting to Small Samples sets up the incentives, biases, and tradeoffs driving the choice.

discovery.text: Over-Fitting to Small Samples reveals the behavioral mechanism driving the outcome.

twist.text: Experts over-fit too. Fund managers with three years of good returns are treated as geniuses.

climax.text: Before changing strategy based on recent events, ask: is this a real pattern or a small sample?

punchline.text: Three data points are a coincidence, not a conclusion.

quiz.question: What is over-fitting in strategic decision-making?
options: Using too much data to make decisions
Treating random patterns in small samples as meaningful signals
Perfectly matching strategy to the game environment
